WFRP4PR.Settings.EnableNegotiation.Name: Enable haggling
WFRP4PR.Settings.EnableNegotiation.Hint: Intercept Item Piles merchant trades and resolve an opposed WFRP4E negotiation before money and items move.
WFRP4PR.Settings.AutoMerchantOpposedRoll: If enabled, the merchant automatically rolls their opposed haggling test without opening a dialog for the GM.
WFRP4PR.Settings.AutoAvailability.Name: Auto-roll merchant availability
WFRP4PR.Settings.AutoAvailability.Hint: When a GM creates or turns an NPC into an Item Piles merchant, roll WFRP4E availability for its inventory.
WFRP4PR.Settings.Settlement.Name: Default settlement size
WFRP4PR.Settings.Settlement.Hint: Settlement size used for automatic merchant availability rolls.
WFRP4PR.Settings.AvailabilityModifier.Hi: Modifier applied to WFRP4E availability rolls. Positive values make items easier to find.
WFRP4PR.Settings.HideUnavailable.Name: Hide unavailable items
WFRP4PR.Settings.HideUnavailable.Hint: If enabled, unavailable merchant items are hidden as well as marked not for sale.
WFRP4PR.Settings.ChatAvailability.Name: Post availability to chat
WFRP4PR.Settings.ChatAvailability.Hint: Post a summary when merchant availability is rolled.
WFRP4PR.Settings.EnableDoorActions.Name: Enable locked door actions
WFRP4PR.Settings.EnableDoorActions.Hint: When a player clicks a locked door, show a dialog to pick the lock or break it down.
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultLockDifficul: Default difficulty used to pick unconfigured locked doors.
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultLockSL.Name: Default lock SL
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultLockSL.Hint: Default minimum SL required to pick a lock.
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultTB.Name: Default door TB
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultTB.Hint: Default Toughness Bonus for doors being broken down.
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultWounds.Name: Default door Wounds
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorDefaultWounds.Hint: Default Wounds for doors being broken down.
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorBashDifficulty.Name: Break door difficulty
WFRP4PR.Settings.DoorBashDifficulty.Hint: Default Melee (Brawling) test difficulty for breaking down a door.
WFRP4PR.Lore.Tzeentch.Name: Lore of Tzeentch
WFRP4PR.Lore.Tzeentch.TestSuccess: Tzeentch's change turns in the target's favor.
WFRP4PR.Lore.Tzeentch.TestFailure: The target is marked by Tzeentch's corruption.
WFRP4PR.Dialog.BuySkill.Title: Negotiate Purchase
WFRP4PR.Dialog.BuySkill.Content: Choose the skill used by {actor} to negotiate {item}.
WFRP4PR.Dialog.SellSkill.Title: Negotiate Sale
WFRP4PR.Dialog.SellSkill.Content: Negotiate the sale price for {item} with Haggle, or sell it without negotiating.
WFRP4PR.MerchantConfig.NegotiationEnable: Uncheck this for the actor to use normal Item Piles trades without haggling.
